text: clara-design: Quick design pass on retention modal + region dropdown + encryption indicator. Figma attached. Main asks: microcopy that avoids implying we hold keys, clear CSV headers, and keyboard/a11y fixes. noah-eng: For default region, we should show the org default at the top. If org has no default, show a small fallback line 'Fallback: Global'. Don't auto-switch based on browser locale. ivy-copy: Copy options (short): 1) "Retention period 10 days (storage region: ap-southeast-1)" 2) "Data retained for 10 days. Storage region: ap-southeast-1." I prefer #1 for compactness. sam-a11y: Accessibility nits: the encryption badge is decorative now. Make it keyboard-focusable and announced. Don't use role=img. Use tabindex=0 with aria-describedby linking to a hidden description. Also include the selected region in the region picker's accessible name. alejandra-legal: Legal note: avoid wording that implies custody of keys. Use phrases like "managed by your KMS" or "under your KMS policy". No ARNs or key IDs in tooltips. mark-pm: CSV changes: map internal ids to human headers: region_id -> "Storage region", policy_id -> "Retention policy". Add an "Encryption" column with values "Platform-managed" or "Customer-managed (KMS region: ap-southeast-1)". noah-eng: Implementation detail: export human-readable region strings, not slugs or ids. For the UI badge, keep label short: "Customer-managed" / "Platform-managed" and full tooltip for details. Mobile tooltips should be concise. ivy-copy: Suggested on-hover tooltip: "Customer-managed encryption key (managed by your KMS, region: ap-southeast-1)." Mark/legal ok with that? alejandra-legal: Replace "key" with "encryption key" in the tooltip and avoid implying Redwood custody. The suggested text is fine otherwise. sam-a11y: Small code snippet for devs (avoid role=img): ``` Customer-managed Encryption type Customer-managed encryption key, managed by your KMS, region: ap-southeast-1 ``` Ensure visible 2px focus ring and 3:1 contrast for badge text. clara-design: I'll update the Figma: use Ivy's #1 copy, add "Org default" tag at top of list, and include the muted "Fallback: Global" state. Will push a new prototype and tag the thread. staging-bot: Staging build 2026-03-25T11:22:01 available: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/retention (a11y snapshot attached). mark-pm: Once deployed can someone run SR checks on the badge and confirm CSV headers? Tag @sam-a11y and @ivy-copy for review. clara-design: Thanks all 44d I'll notify when PR lands for quick pass.
